state_authority.observable_facade: ChatViewModel remains the single App-held @Observable identity; messages, inputText, isLoading and approval facades project currentRun.state.
state_authority.per_conversation: ChatConversationRunRegistry owns one ChatConversationRun per conversation key; each run owns one ChatConversationRunState and optional ChatKernelRunHost.
state_authority.async_attachment: ChatAttachmentOperationOwner owns selected-file request token, vision request/conversation tokens, task and bounded OCR cache; visible attachment data remains on ChatViewModel and current run as before.
state_authority.suggestion_request: ChatSuggestionRequestOwner owns one cancellable visible-composer suggestion token/task.
state_authority.mailbox: ChatConversationRunState owns in-memory steer queue and child wait; ChatConversationInboxIO owns injected sidecar/mailbox/event transports.
state_authority.persistence: ChatConversationPersistence.commit owns snapshot/CAS/variant transaction against IOSConversationStore; VM only selects target run and triggers branch signal.
state_authority.view_local: ChatView retains one @State ChatViewModel, input controller, artifact pin handler, summary, viewport/shelf, Namespace and focused presentation; three @State value groups own composer/picker/browser local fields.
state_authority.ledger_logger: File-private chatLedgerLogger now sits beside its only use in ChatRunComposition.swift.

visibility.existing_facade: All declarations that were non-private in the pre-edit source retain their external name/signature; ChatViewModel observable wrappers project per-conversation run state.
concrete_owner_narrow_interface: ChatComposerApprovalCards typed properties and Binding inputs

baseline_declaration_coverage.ChatViewModel: 326 of 326 original 4-space declarations accounted for; three async attachment token fields moved and renamed: visionRecognitionRequestId -> visionRequestId, visionRecognitionConversationId -> visionConversationId, attachRequestId -> selectedFileRequestId
